context: The scene takes place at the Gur Tribe's camp during a ritual pyre of burned possessions; the Gur are a tribe of monster‑hunters. Ulma is the tribe’s leader and addresses the player and Astarion (in some versions Astarion may be absent and Ulma speaks directly to the player); Gandrel, the Gur Hunter from Act 1, may also be present if he survived. Ulma accuses Astarion of involvement in the kidnapping of the tribe’s children and explains the tribe previously attacked Cazador Szarr’s palace but failed to get in. Because Astarion is one of Cazador’s spawn and might be welcomed inside, Ulma offers an uneasy truce and asks him to infiltrate the palace to save the children; Astarion warns Cazador is merciless and the player may choose whether to help.
